entities.summary: Nathan Paetsch is a Canadian ice hockey coach and former ice hockey defenceman who played in the National Hockey League (NHL) with the Buffalo Sabres and Columbus Blue Jackets. He is currently an assistant coach of the Rochester Americans in the American Hockey League.
